content.text: § 22 already sits at our preferred AUDIT position, so no redline was proposed. Frequency (once per 12 months), notice (30 days' written), business hours, independent auditor bound by confidentiality, off-site where practicable, Vendor-borne cost subject to a 5% underpayment trigger, and the express bar on direct access to our systems are all present, and no other clause in the document grants Vendor audit or usage-verification rights against us.
